The maintainer decided on 2026-11-18 that the project completes an outside PR when its last author activity is more than 24 hours old. The purpose is to get your work into `main` and not to let it wait behind conflicts. This PR is in that group.

What we do:
- An agent of this repository merges `main` into your branch and corrects the open review findings. Your commits stay as they are. We do not rebase and we do not force-push.
- The agent pushes to your branch, because this PR permits edits by maintainers.
- A different agent reviews the result. The PR merges when that review is clean.
- Each step gets a comment on this PR.

If you want to do this work yourself, write a comment here. Then we stop and the PR stays with you.

A refresh of this PR against `main` (`0ea577707`) was tried on the maintainer's order of 2026-11-18. The refresh stopped. Nothing was pushed. The head is still 9637869a71f59aa3c157e624e4cb1e51103198a1.

Why it stopped: the two sides changed the same WCS page logic.

- This PR removes the "Set Origin" button from the `Level` row of `wcs_page` in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs`. It applies the origin from the footer (`wcs_footer::footer`).
- `main` moved the WCS page to `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_page.rs` (#739). Later PRs changed the page (#1648, #1720, #1542). The button is now in an equal-width row at `wcs_page.rs:146` (`even_row(ui, &["Level", "Set Origin"], ...)`).
- The tests of `main` need that button: `wcs_page_tests.rs:100-102` and `wcs_page_tests.rs:268`.
- The test of this PR, `set_origin_sits_in_the_footer_beside_close_and_nowhere_else`, permits only one apply button.

A decision is necessary: "Set Origin" moves to the footer and the layout tests of `main` change, or the button stays in the row.

The second conflict is not a problem. In `crates/app/src/setup_sheet/sections.rs` (`render_wcs`), the `origin:` line of this PR and the `setup::wcs_name` line of `main` can stay together.

The refresh agent did not change the labels or the draft state.

**Verdict: no blockers**

Full review of the PR diff against main (merge base `210984013`), of the remerge-diff of merge `14e4f9c97`, and of commit `de0891e00`. The head merges cleanly with the current main (`ee49b068`, `git merge-tree`).

## Checks

1. **Everything Is a Command.** The footer button calls `wcs_page::apply_wcs_drafts` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_footer.rs:51-53`). That function queues the undoable `SetWcs` command (`wcs_page.rs:327-334`). No UI code writes the WCS transform. Typed drafts that are not applied stay in `state.wcs_ui` only. The footer flags them with "Origin not applied". Nothing reads the drafts for posting.
   - This PR cannot change a posted offset. `app::setup_origin` only reads the WCS transform and the stock or model box, and it makes text. `setup::wcs_slot` is not touched. The setup sheet keeps main's `program offset:` line from `setup::wcs_name` (`crates/app/src/setup_sheet/sections.rs:127-134`).
   - `pending()` compares rotations as quaternions, by the same `quat_from_euler` that the draft path uses. A non-finite draft reads as pending. This is correct.
2. **Main's WCS page is complete.** The remerge-diff of `14e4f9c97` takes main's `wcs_page.rs` and changes only the action row in `quarter_turns`. The turn rows, `flip_row`, Level, the milling tilt disables, the anchor section, the compass, the circle pick and the readout stay. The `pages.rs` conflict hunks drop only the branch's old copies of `machine_section` and `wcs_page`. Main's versions of the two are kept. Tool, Stock, Model and SetupNode pages keep their plain Close (`pages.rs:161-167`).
3. **Layers and code shape.** The UI uses `camcraft_app` APIs and `CommandKind` only. There is no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` outside tests. The new files are small (`setup_origin.rs` 118 lines, `wcs_footer.rs` 60 lines, `wcs_page.rs` 349 lines).
4. **Tests.** The new tests assert labels, the one-row placement, the count of apply buttons, the flag and the placed position after a click. The ui `#[test]` count goes up by 3 (the author reports 1266 against 1263). No snapshot PNG changes.
   - **The 900 px window is a fair fix.** The page body is in a `ScrollArea` with `max_height(content_height)`, and the footer is drawn after it, outside the scroll area (`pages.rs:103-106`, `160-168`). At the default 720 px window, the footer with Set origin and Close stays in view. The body gets a scroll bar, and the bottom row of the compass (SW, S, SE) is below the fold until the user scrolls. Nothing is clipped. The test cannot click a cell that is out of view, so the taller window is correct for the test.
5. **Setup sheet.** The new `origin:` line comes before main's `program offset:` line, and the two are kept (`sections.rs:127-134`). `setup_wcs.rs::the_setup_sheet_says_where_the_origin_is_in_words` pins the corner, centre and off-anchor cases.
6. **PR body.** It has screenshots (before, after, after with a typed value), a `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #870`. The decision file has the Chosen, Why and Dropped entries. This PR adds no new command, so it needs no MCP tool.

## Non-blocking findings

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs` is 682 lines on main and grows by 9 lines here. The file was already above the 400-line limit before this PR. A split is a separate P7 item.
- `wcs_footer.rs:51`: Set origin is always enabled. A click with no pending edit queues a `SetWcs` that changes nothing, and that adds an undo step with no effect. Think about `ui.add_enabled(pending, ...)` and an enabled-state assert in `wcs_footer` tests.
- `wcs_footer.rs:24` and `sections.rs:130`: the text "(X0 Y0 Z0)" is coordinate notation in a user-facing string. The heading already shows the offset word. This is small, but the plain-English rule for UI text applies. A text such as "the program's zero point" is an alternative.
- `wcs_footer.rs:50-57`: the footer row is `ui.horizontal`. In a narrow property pane, the "Origin not applied" label can be cut at the right edge. Think about `horizontal_wrapped`.
- `sections.rs:129`: the sheet writes the origin distances in mm only. This agrees with the other lines of the sheet. It does not follow the document's program units (#902). That is an existing condition of the sheet.
- The origin words use the world-frame box. The decision file says so for rotated or aligned setups (#326). This is acceptable as recorded.
